question: The classic triad of loin pain, haematuria, and a palpable loin mass occurs in the majority of patients with renal cell carcinoma at presentation.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — false. The classic triad of haematuria, loin pain, and a loin mass is a late presentation seen in fewer than 15% of patients; the majority of RCCs are now found incidentally on CT or ultrasound.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This is false. The classic triad occurs in only 10–15% of RCC cases. Most RCCs today are detected incidentally on imaging done for other reasons; many patients have no symptoms at all.
